5228 jihvā́ f. 'tongue' RV. 2. juhū́- f. RV. 1. Pa. jivhā - f., Pk. jibbhā - f., jĭ̄hā - f., Gy. SEeur. čhib ,
eur. čib f., as. dib , pal. ǰib , Ḍ. ǰiba , Kt. dīċ (< * dij̈ < * j̈ij̈ <* ǰij̈ ), Wg. ǰip (← Paš.), Dm. žip , Tir. ǰub , Paš.lauṛ. ǰiba-m 'my tongue', ar. zīp , Niṅg. zip , Shum. zīb , Woṭ. zib f., Gaw. zib , zip , Kal. rumb. ǰip , Bshk. ǰib , Tor. ǰīb ,
Mai. zīb , Kand. žip , Sv. žiba , Phal. ǰib f., Sh. gil. ǰip ,
pl. ǰibĕ f., koh. ǰib f., gur. žib f., K. zĕv f., pog. ziū , kash. zĕou , rām. zibh , ḍoḍ. jib , S. j̄ibha f., L. jibbh , (Ju.) j̄ibh f., awāṇ. jībh , P. jībh f. (← H.), bhaṭ. jibbh , WPah.
bhad. zibbh , rudh, j̈ìb , pl. j̈ìbba , paṅ. jibh , cam. cur. jibbh , Ku. jībh f., j̈ibṛo m., °ṛī f., gng. j̈ibaṛ ; N. jib ( h ) ro 'tongue', jibri 'barb of fish hook, tongue of flame'; A. zibhā 'tongue', B. jib , Or. jibha , Bhoj. jībhⁱ , Aw. lakh. jībh , H. jīb ( h ) f., G. jībh , jibhṛī f., M. jībh f., Ko. jīb ( h ) a ,
Si. diva ; — Pk. jīhā -, jihā - f., Mth. jīhᵃ , jihᵃ , OAw. jīha ,
H. jīh f., kal-jīhā 'black-tongued'. 2. Ash. žū 'tongue', Pr. luzuk (< * duj̈u - < * j̈uj̈u - < * ǰuj̈u -). * jihviya-; *jihvākīla-, jihvāgra-; gōjihvā -. Addenda: jihvā́-: S.kcch. jibbh f. 'tongue', WPah.kṭg. j̈ibbh f., kc. j̈ībh f. (obl. - a ), J. jībh f., Garh. jīb ( h ), Mth. jibhelā ,
(SETirhut) jihelā , (NETirhut) jihlā 'right-hand peg
passing through roller of weaver's loom preventing it
from revolving' Grierson BPL 75 with illustration;
Md. dulek , dulu , dū 'tongue' (- l - by anal. with other
words ending in a long vowel).

5231.text:
5231 * jihviya 'pertaining to or like a tongue'. [ jihvā́ -] Pk. jibbhiyā - f. 'tongue, something shaped like a
tongue'; S. j̄ibhī f. 'flame'; N. Or. jibhi 'tongue scraper',
H. jībhī f.; G. jībhī f. 'sail hung on foremast'. Addenda: * jihviya-: S.kcch. jibbhī f. 'dry saliva on the tongue'.
